title: Exception cost, measured
prompt: Implement `static long ThrowCatchCost(int iterations)`: capture Stopwatch ticks for `iterations` throw+catch cycles of a pre-created exception instance (throw ex; inside try, catch { }) and return the elapsed milliseconds. Then implement `static long ErrorCodeCost(int iterations)` doing the same work but returning -1 instead of throwing (checked, same loop shape). Implement `static int Divide(int a, int b)` that throws DivideByZeroException on b==0 — used by the test once to verify the exception path works.

tests.name: divide-throws
tests.hint: if (b == 0) throw new DivideByZeroException(); return a / b.

tests.name: costs-measured
tests.hint: Pre-create the exception ONCE (new Exception() outside the loop); Stopwatch.StartNew() → loop → .ElapsedMilliseconds.
